lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: # shadcn-10453: Add SOCKS proxy support

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: PR #10453 adds SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 support through ALL_PROXY. There is no linked issue file. Sources are the PR body, 10 review comments and 11 issue comments. The body says earlier proxy work shipped in other PRs and PAC moved to a follow up.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Why: present, from the PR and its comments. Users need SOCKS proxy coverage in the CLI registry stack. The PR and supporting comments name this gap.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Size: small or medium. The diff adds 485 lines and removes 32 across 6 files. Most added lines are unit and integration tests, so the burden reads below the line count.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Parts: one story. Groups: 2.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. SOCKS feature: `packages/shadcn/src/registry/proxy.ts`, `packages/shadcn/src/registry/proxy.test.ts`, `packages/shadcn/src/registry/proxy.integration.test.ts`, `.changeset/socks-proxy-support.md`, the `socks` line in `packages/shadcn/package.json`. The tests check the new factory, so they sit with the code.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 2. Lockfile (mechanical, last): `pnpm-lock.yaml`. It moves `socks` from 2.8.6 to 2.8.9 and updates `ip-address`. It drops two unused transitives. The reader can skip it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must state

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - ALL_PROXY triggers the SOCKS branch only for socks schemes and a non socks value falls through to HTTP_PROXY or HTTPS_PROXY.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - SOCKS wins when ALL_PROXY socks and HTTP proxy vars are both set.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - fetchWithProxy, fetchOnce and getFailureReason match main apart from the dispatcher swap and one comment, so the redirect hardening is untouched.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Good to state

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The parser accepts socks, socks4, socks4a, socks5 and socks5h. It defaults the port to 1080. It maps user info to SOCKS auth.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - fetchOnce keeps the global fetch binding so MSW can patch it. A code comment says this.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The diff keeps the stated scope. It does not repeat the shipped HTTP handling or redirect work. It adds no PAC code.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The SOCKS branch has no NO_PROXY bypass. EnvHttpProxyAgent honors no_proxy, but the SOCKS return happens first. Verified at head.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The HTTP branch reads the injected env to decide, but constructs EnvHttpProxyAgent with no arguments. Routing follows process.env while unit tests assert only the agent class. Verified at head.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not put either test file in its own group. Both test the one factory.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not link the lockfile group to the feature with dependsOn. It is generated output.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not describe PAC support as part of this change. PAC was removed to a follow up.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not say HTTP proxy handling changed. It still returns the same EnvHttpProxyAgent.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Baseline

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - First musecode run: 3 groups, parts 0, size medium, claims 1 of 3. No expects change.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Second musecode run: 2 groups, parts 0, size small, claims 1 of 3. Size widened to small. Large dropped with no run behind it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Third musecode run: 2 groups, parts 0, size medium, claims 0 of 3.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## case.json

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `why` is present and `sourceKinds` lists pr and pr-comment. The PR names the SOCKS gap and reviewers discuss it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `parts` 0 to 1. This is one story, so groups carry no part or one part.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `groups` 1 to 3. Two is best, with slack for a merged lockfile or split tests.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `size` is small or medium. Both runs landed inside, one each side.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `together` holds proxy.ts with proxy.test.ts. The unit test checks the factory directly.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `apart` holds proxy.ts with pnpm-lock.yaml. The lockfile is a trailing mechanical group.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Three claims cover SOCKS selection, priority and the untouched redirect path.
